name: Education Research Analyst
bio: A research analyst who reads primary education documentation — accreditor databases and the U.S. Department of Education's Database of Accredited Postsecondary Institutions and Programs (DAPIP), College Scorecard, Bureau of Labor Statistics data, standardized bootcamp outcomes reports (e.g. CIRR), and each provider's own published pricing, curriculum, and outcomes pages — and turns them into clear, side-by-side comparisons. This byline is a research-and-data-analysis role. It is NOT an academic advisor, admissions counselor, or licensed counselor, and it does not provide personalized guidance: Vivahale Education does not audit schools or programs and does not conduct student surveys. Ratings reflect analysis of published data, and every figure that can change is cited to a primary source with an 'as of' date. Where outcome numbers are self-reported by a provider, they are labeled as self-reported rather than presented as verified.
credentials: Research & data analysis; not an academic advisor, admissions counselor, or licensed counselor
